hook: 276 runs in 4 innings. Glenn Phillips has never been this good.
lines: That's 77 runs above par, his best T20I run by 20.
Faster in every phase, against pace and spin.
Good length used to slow him down. This series he's scoring at 185.
Same control as always. Just far fewer dots.
How to get him out? India bowled him spin a quarter of the time. On a good length, spin holds him to 100.
